title: Liquid Fluoride Thorium Reactor
path: RS2-1: The inanimate, physics, chemistry, astronomy

posts.content:
I came across a video talking about "Liquid Fluoride Thorium Reactor." And I think this is something people like ourselves really need to get behind and help push to make happen. Here is the video, and I would appreciate any comments and discussion on how to promote this technology.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YVSmf_qmkbg

Yes, the LFTR seems to be a better fission reactor...but it is still fission.

RST should allow us to unwind matter in a simpler way, allowing for one per-home FE device.
